crossRefs.note: Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
Do you seek great things for yourself? Don’t seek them; for, behold, I will bring evil on all flesh,’ says Yahweh; ‘but…
Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body…
For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…
Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

parallels.note: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.
Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.
and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.
Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

translations.web: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.
translations.bsb: On that day, let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve his possessions. Likewise, let no one in the field return for anything he has left behind.
translations.kjv: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
translations.asv: In that day, he that shall be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away: and let him that is in the field likewise not return back.
